result.reason: The added Insurance provision fully satisfies the stated fallback but omits every other preferred coverage requirement and uses the fallback E&O and cyber limits. The redline is not minimal because it also relocates the pre-existing Receivables fragment from before Section 10.13 to after that section. That relocation may sever the fragment from its original provision and impair an unrelated term, so the redline does not reliably preserve the original agreement's intent. The insurance sentence itself is concise and operative.
